progression.intro: Your level comes from your total XP. Each rank unlocks more threads, and the daily limit is threads × {{per}} games per day.

contribute.title: How to contribute
contribute.step2: Find a game / pack and submit a correction (text, image or video) - or a whole art pack.
contribute.step3: A reviewer approves it. Once approved, the XP is credited automatically.
contribute.step4: Your level rises automatically, unlocking new threads without spending anything.
contribute.note: XP reflects approved work only. Rejected or pending submissions do not earn XP.

donations.title: Support NeoAssets & get boosted
donations.intro: Not everyone has time to contribute metadata, but you can still help cover server costs (Cloudflare R2, databases). Donations grant immediate technical perks, but they never grant XP or ranks - ranks must be earned with real contributions.
donations.fairPlay: Your active threads are your base threads (from your level) plus your donor bonus, hard-capped at {{max}} threads. That means a monthly supporter already reaches maximum scraping speed at a lower level; the top levels stay pure community prestige.

supporter.perk: +{{threads}} bonus threads added to your base threads, and +{{xp}}% XP on all future contributions.
supporter.bonus: A permanent Supporter badge on your profile.
supporter.note: Ideal for a solid scraping boost without the initial grind.

monthly_supporter.perk: +{{threads}} bonus threads added to your base threads, and +{{xp}}% XP on all future contributions.
monthly_supporter.bonus: A glowing Monthly Supporter badge on your profile.
monthly_supporter.note: If you cancel, you keep the Supporter badge.

apiDocs.title: Scraping API
apiDocs.subtitle: Public, credential-gated API for game metadata and media.
apiDocs.authIntro: Every request requires developer application credentials. A user credential is optional; without it the request runs in guest mode (2 threads, low rate limit).
apiDocs.quotaBody: The daily limit is threads × 1,000 games (guest 2 threads = 2,000/day, registered 4 = 4,000/day, admin 16 = 16,000/day). Threads also set scraping concurrency. Counters reset at 00:00 UTC and are reported in the X-Quota-* response headers.
apiDocs.credentialsHint: create and manage your developer apps and personal API keys.
apiDocs.systemsDesc: Metadata system catalog with game counts, family and group. Free (does not consume quota).
apiDocs.familiesDesc: Broad system families (arcade, console, computer, handheld, virtual) with their system and game counts. Free (does not consume quota).
apiDocs.groupsDesc: System groups (emulator sub-sets such as mame-fbneo, flycast) with their system and game counts. Free (does not consume quota).
apiDocs.conceptsIntro: The catalog has three levels. Understanding them makes /scrape/games easy: pick the level that matches what you have.
apiDocs.conceptsFamilyDesc: The broad category: arcade, console, computer, handheld, virtual. The arcade family contains every arcade board.
apiDocs.conceptsGroupDesc: A sub-set of a family, by emulator. In arcade: mame-fbneo, flycast, supermodel, dolphin.
apiDocs.conceptsSystemDesc: The concrete board you browse: cps1, cps2, cps3, neogeo, naomi... This is what GET /scrape/systems lists.
apiDocs.conceptsVirtualDesc: A system that owns no games and aggregates its group (when set) or family. arc is virtual, so it covers the whole arcade family without duplicating games.
apiDocs.conceptsPickIntro: Use exactly one of system_id, family or group.
apiDocs.conceptsPickSystem: You know the exact board -> system_id=cps2
apiDocs.conceptsPickFamily: You have one arcade folder and want every arcade game -> family=arcade
apiDocs.conceptsPickVirtual: Same as family, through the virtual system -> system_id=arc
apiDocs.conceptsPickGroup: You only want the boards that run on MAME/FBNeo -> group=mame-fbneo
apiDocs.conceptsPickName: You have a ROM file -> name=sfa3.zip. The name matches the display name or the short ROM set name, so filenames work.
apiDocs.conceptsExampleNote: All four return the same game. The response's system_id tells you the real board (cps2) and rom_name its ROM set (sfa3.zip).
apiDocs.gamesDesc: Resolve a single game by ROM hash (crc/md5/sha1/sha256) or name, scoped to a system_id, a family or a group (exactly one). A family searches every system of the category at once; a group narrows it by emulator (e.g. mame-fbneo). Hash wins; if it misses and a name is given, it falls back to the name (best match). Returns the game with its metadata, media URLs and scrapes counter; game is null when nothing matched. Consumes one quota unit.
apiDocs.accountDesc: Current subject (user or guest) and remaining quota. Free.
apiDocs.err429: Rate limit or daily quota exceeded.
apiDocs.pHashes: ROM identification. Hash wins over name; falls back to the name on a miss.
apiDocs.pName: Game name or ROM filename; the extension and (region)/[tags] are stripped before matching.
apiDocs.pSystemId: System to search in, from GET /scrape/systems. Exactly one of system_id, family or group is required.
apiDocs.pFamily: Broad system family to search across, from GET /scrape/families (e.g. arcade = every arcade board). Exactly one of system_id, family or group is required.
apiDocs.pGroup: System group (emulator sub-set) to search across, from GET /scrape/groups (e.g. mame-fbneo). Exactly one of system_id, family or group is required.
apiDocs.pMedia: Comma-separated kinds: cover, boxfront, boxback, screenshot, logo, fanart, video.
apiDocs.pSoftname: Client version name for per-version statistics. Defaults to the app name.
apiDocs.pDebug: Developer debug password (header only, max 100 debug calls/day).
apiDocs.pForceUsed: Debug. Report this value as the daily used counter.
apiDocs.pForceThreads: Debug. Override the thread count for the request.
apiDocs.popularDesc: Most scraped games, optionally filtered by system_id and limited with limit. Free (does not consume quota).
apiDocs.pType: Optional filter for a name search: base, hack or homebrew (ignored when a hash is sent).
apiDocs.pRoms: Include the full ROM list. Off by default; rom_count is always returned.
